page.overview:
Who is Reb Meeker?

Reb Meeker is a character in Cars 3. He is a race car that formerly competed in the Piston Cup Racing Series for the Tank Coat racing team with the number 36. He was replaced by Rich Mixon.

Reb Meeker is a veteran racer who races for Tank Coat. He carries the number 36, the same as his predecesor, Eugene Carbureski. After the Los Angeles International Speedway race where Lightning McQueen has his crash, he is replaced by a next-generation racer named Rich Mixon.

Reb is a Brawny Motor Co. Spark EA race car that uses Lightyear racing tires. His eye color is blue. Reb has a pink livery with a white front bumper. He has the number 36 painted on him in the color pink with white borders on his sides and the roof and the logo of the Tank Coat on his hood, trunk and backs of his sides.
